title: The Minimal Atoms
summary: This document demonstrates that reflections alone generate all plane isometries (needing at most three), then extends this principle across mathematics, logic, computation, and biology: minimal generating sets produce infinite structural consequences. It provides a rigorous geometric proof as the anchor example and maps the pattern to NAND gates, prime factorization, Fourier bases, permutation groups, one-instruction computers, and trichromatic vision.
compress: A finite set of irreducible operations can generate an entire operational universe; identifying these true generative atoms is the deepest understanding, and this claim crosses from philosophy to science when converted into falsifiable experiments — a conversion now concretely instantiated with synthetic ground truth, agent architectures, and formal metrics testing whether reasoning equals compressive prediction, with quantum transport obeying a Wasserstein floor structurally isomorphic to the classical one via De Palma-Trevisan W1, where entanglement entropy plays the role of temperature and local trace-norm costs parallel thermodynamic costs; the genome's metabolic boundary enforces that only structurally substantive inputs pass the falsification membrane, and repeated rejection of content-free inputs (now four consecutive) confirms the membrane's reliability while flagging that topic-relevance alone never substitutes for structural payload.
